title.narrative: Start Fund Mozambique Response to Cyclone Freddy - PA contribution

description.narrative: Oxfam and Kukumbi intend to support vulnerable communities to prepare for, respond to and build resilience to Tropical Storm Freddy and other after effects such as waterborne diseases with this donation through the provision of Water Sanitation and Hygiene (WASH) Non Food Item (NFI) to vulnerable community members, rehabilitation/protecting water points such as wells and springs, promoting community training in hygiene and preparedness, training community health workers in hygiene, gender, protection and providing WASH kits and food assistance to 500 families and dignity kits to 250 women and girls of reproductive age, including tools to collect and store water for affected communities to promote personal and household hygiene. The other action that will be considered is the installation of hand wash stations in accommodation centres and in places where there are more people; all of which will help to prevent the spread of cholera outbreaks and other WASH -related illnesses. Oxfam and Kukumbi will assess the functionality and quality of water sources in communities affected by the floods to determine the level of repair and disinfection measures, respectively. This will be done at water facilities in target communities. A gender and protection analysis will be carried out to support the design of response strategies that effectively address the needs of girls, boys, women and men affected by the crisis; ensure that our programming integrates, mitigates and responds to gender -based violence. This will be done through gender and protection awareness campaigns and support for protection frameworks to keep up with the changes. Activities related to communication for greater visibility of project impacts will be considered.
